text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's lunchtime, and the school store is crammed full of students. Matikanetannhauser is at the very end of the line.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …I shall impart a divine message from the great Shiraoki. Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gulp! Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today, like most days, shall bring you a frenzy of great fortune! Lunch time portends particularly good luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wowieee! So you're saying I'll finally be able to get my hands on the bread that always sells out?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Melon bread, cream buns, carrot bread. ♪ Bready, bready, breaaad!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Sorry, everyone! The melon bread, cream buns, and carrot bread are all sold out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! But I'm supposed to have great fortune today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Th-that's so strange… Could I have made a mistake in my divination?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, no, it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It must mean my great fortune isn't related to bread!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Off to the cafe, where my lucky break awaits! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm coming too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overcome with curiosity, I decide to follow the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! Take a look at this signboard!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "New menu item: Stewed Carrot Hamburger Steak!" And it's limited to only ten customers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This has to be it! It's your destiny to acquire this rare lunch today, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them line up and wait for their turn to order. But…

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but the Stewed Carrot Hamburger Steak is all sold out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! You're sold out too?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah?! Wh-what's going on?! How could the great Shiraoki's divination mislead us not just once, but twice?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can practically see the good luck awaiting us! This is so very strange!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… You saw all that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, being one step away and still missing out is so like me… Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Buuut…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Lunch time isn't over yet! The bread and new hamburger steak were sold out, but there must be an even luckier lunch waiting for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aha! That's it! I get it now! The key is your unbreakable spirit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You brave any headwind—that's why my divination said you've got a super dose of luck coming your way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's right, Fuku! There's no doubt in my mind that I'll get my hands on an ultra-rare lunch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The only question is, where am I gonna find it? Muuun…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Where do you think my ultra-rare lunch is hiding, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's march right back to the school shop!
Let's wait patiently for fortune to come to us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see. Going back to the beginning. That might just work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Indeed! The divine message did say the good omen was at the school store, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aww, everything's sold out. Where's my ultra-rare lunch?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, perfect timing! We just got a batch of all-new products in. Would you like to try a sample?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's see here… "Supreme Grape Bread"?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can smell the fruity aroma from here!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the sample! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser and Matikanefukukitaru dig into the delicious new bread with relish!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see. So if I just stay as I am now, the fortune will come to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Allow me to perform a prayer to invite even greater fortune! Ommmmm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yummy yummy lunch! Chewy chewy munch! Kiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you two. Have you still not had any lunch?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's right. We're suuuper hungry.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: You can have my lunch, if you'd like. I did so much taste-testing while I was working that I can't eat another bite.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! Spring rolls, hamburger steak, oden… There's so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The cafe lady's personal lunch is bound to be delicious! This must be what the divine message was referring to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser and Matikanefukukitaru enjoy the ultra-rare lunch together!
